text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, <chrname> defeated Orfevre 
in the Representative Exchange Race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the King who showed her the 
perspective, pride, and heart of "one who 
bears the burden," she tried to offer 
words as the one who received the baton, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only acceptable outcome was winning 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. She 
declared that they had better get as 
strong as possible, until the day she 
crushed them herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And—Orfevre, who had declined to represent 
Japan, imparted a "royal decree" to us: 
"Achieve victory."
